about:
PFI Fashions Inc operates from Genoa City, Wisconsin, providing wholesale and contract apparel decoration services. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The shop specializes in screen printing, embroidery, and direct-to-film (DTF) heat transfers, along with private labeling, patches, and a line of sideline vests and sports bibs. It markets a range of branded promotional products sourced from national suppliers, offering customization across multiple decoration methods.

Its customer base spans the promotional marketing sector, serving businesses and organizations that require custom-decorated apparel and branded merchandise for campaigns, uniforms, and retail. The company emphasizes a continuously expanding catalog of national brands to simplify procurement for promotional distributors and end-users alike.

PFI Fashions positions itself as a one-stop resource for wholesale apparel decoration, highlighting its ability to streamline the shopping process through a broad selection of prestige brands and in-house decoration capabilities.
